title: An expert sees the listing
hook: Does professional experience remove a visible price anchor?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Compare an appraisal made with a listing price against one made without it.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Compare an appraisal made with a listing price against one made without it.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: A toy appraisal rule gives equal weight to €100k comparable sales and a €140k listing. What appraisal does that rule produce? Toy inputs A=[100, 140]; B=[100, 80].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[120, 100, 140], [90, 100, 80]]. Labels: Blend €k, Comps €k, Listing €k.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: The appraisal rule deliberately mixes comparable sales with the listing. Changing only the listing moves its output. This demonstrates a possible anchoring mechanism, not a measured response by real experts.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Comps €k=100, Listing €k=80. What is Blend €k? Answer: 90.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Comps €k=100, Listing €k=80. What is Blend €k?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 90. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: Real estate agents' appraisals shifted with the listing price they were shown, though most denied using it (Northcraft & Neale, 1987).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Compare an appraisal made with a listing price against one made without it.
